scope: Current-original algorithm stages only; unchanged convex slope, standing/aim and parameters. CPU approximation, not captured game intermediate textures.

stages.title: ① 输入：墙形、灯口和朝向
stages.explanation: L=(-0.75,1.1)，向下93.44°；红虚线是未遮挡光束外边界。

stages.title: ② 灯口光束＋距离衰减（未遮挡）
stages.explanation: 按原灯口宽0.967、锥角46.2°、强度2.78、照距24计算；暂不测试墙体。

stages.title: ③ 直射遮挡后：D
stages.explanation: 原五个灯口采样做遮挡；部分直射从左端绕出，另一部分落在斜面。NearIntensity=0。

stages.title: ④ 受光墙段：裁取后存33个入射节点
stages.explanation: 准备阶段按同一光束公式另算墙面入射，裁出受光首尾，再重新采样33节点；不是33盏点光。

stages.title: ⑤ 积分入射密度，得到返光目标：T
stages.explanation: SoftBlob用径向核积分节点间的连续密度，取局部照度I；匹配模式T=2*(0.8I+0.2M)。

stages.title: ⑥ 圆形核的覆盖／距离衰减：C
stages.explanation: C来自径向核权重积分，R=4.69格。本场景距离门控F=1；圆形外围已经连续归零。

stages.title: ⑦ 扣除已有直射，得到正余量：E
stages.explanation: E=DNPositiveExcess(T,D)，近似max(T-D,0)，零附近有小过渡；因此直射区会出现补光缺口。

stages.title: ⑧ 遮挡前返光：U＝E×C×F
stages.explanation: U=E*C*F。到这一步尚未使用返光遮挡，可见圆润原光团与直射扣除的形状。

stages.title: ⑨ 探针可见性：V（此处产生硬切）
stages.explanation: 两探针按距离加权求V；角落中两探针钳到同一端点，退化成一条硬阴影射线。

stages.title: ⑩ 遮挡后返光：B＝U×V
stages.explanation: U乘V。V从1跳至0时，原本非零的U被直接切断；切面在此进入实际返光。

stages.title: 11 直射＋返光，限制墙内亮度
stages.explanation: 本模型只有一条受光墙段，八槽融合退化为B；加D后，岩体RGB最大通道限制到0.65。

stages.title: 12 加底光、材质和法线后的显示示意
stages.explanation: 游戏写384x216光场，再按几何约束插值、限制墙表层、按直射占比处理Relief，最后加底光乘材质。此图用高精度场和均匀材质示意。

limitations: Analytic convex intersection replaces game grid DDA and fixed-step direct traversal.
One selected reflecting wall segment; the eight-wall merge is the identity in this example, and there is one lamp.
Stages are logical quantities computed for illustration. Several exist only in registers in the game, not as separate textures/passes.
High-resolution scalar fields show the existing formulas, not the game's 384x216 half-float storage/reconstruction.
Final display uses uniform albedo .18, a flat normal, analytic wall depth and no authored textures; real normal maps and exact material reconstruction are not reproduced.
Local-fill affects explicitly bound sprites, not this environment field; the zero near-intensity and continuous mode skip near/legacy branches.
One-sided feather profile is a proposed mask function only. It is not applied in any of the twelve original-stage images; boundary-distance construction and wall barriers remain implementation work.
